title: Woman in Coat and Hat in Yard, 1957 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black-and-white candid portrait of a woman dressed in mid-1950s fashion, featuring a tailored double-breasted coat and matching hat. She poses proudly in a residential backyard next to a flowering shrub, a rustic wooden split-rail fence, and a classic rotary umbrella clothesline outside a white vinyl-sided home. The year 1957 is written on the reverse side of the print.
